Repositories.GitHubUrlHelp: https://api.github.com for github.com; GitHub Enterprise Server: https://<server>/api/v3.
Repositories.GitHubTokenHelp: A personal access token (read access to the contents is enough). Without one only public repositories open, with a low request limit.
Repositories.GitHubListHelp: owner/name, separated by commas: listed in github:/// besides your own. Any other one opens by its path, e.g. github://owner/name.
Repositories.GitLabUrlHelp: https://gitlab.com, or the address of your own GitLab server.
Repositories.GitLabTokenHelp: A personal access token with the read_api scope. Without one only public projects open.
Repositories.GitLabListHelp: group/project (or group/subgroup/project), separated by commas: listed in gitlab:/// besides your own.
Repositories.CannotBeReached: {0} cannot be reached ({1}): check the network connection and the proxy settings.
Repositories.NoAnswer: {0} does not answer ({1}): try again later.
Repositories.RateLimit: The {0} API rate limit is reached; it resets at {1}.
Repositories.RateLimitNoToken: The {0} API rate limit is reached; it resets at {1}. An access token raises the limit (Configuration > Plugins > GitHub / GitLab repositories).
Repositories.TokenRefused: {0} refused the access token: it is wrong or has expired. Change it in Configuration > Plugins > GitHub / GitLab repositories.
Repositories.SignInNeeded: {0} wants a sign-in for this: set an access token in Configuration > Plugins > GitHub / GitLab repositories.
Repositories.NotFoundWithToken: Not found: {0} (or the access token has no access to it).
Repositories.NotFoundNoToken: Not found: {0}. A private repository needs an access token: set one in Configuration > Plugins > GitHub / GitLab repositories.
Repositories.ReadOnly: GitHub and GitLab repositories are read-only here: clone the repository to change its files.
Repositories.OpenRepositoryPrompt: The repository's name (owner/name; GitLab: group/project) or its address:
Repositories.ClonePrompt: The folder to clone {0} into (the folder {1} is made in it):
Repositories.GitNeeded: Cloning needs git: install it from git-scm.com (or set FM_GIT to its path).
